Package dev.gmitch215.bytebox.gradle

Class Bindings

java.lang.Object
dev.gmitch215.bytebox.gradle.Bindings
public class Bindings extends Object
The bindings { } block.

Names are optional. The first binding of a type takes the type's own name and each repeat gains a number, so a project declaring one of each never writes a name down and a project declaring two KV namespaces gets KV and KV_2. 

 bindings {
 	kv()                                    // KV
 	kv()                                    // KV_2
 	kv("SESSIONS") { id = "abc123" }        // an explicit name and a remote id
 	d1()                                    // DB
 	r2()                                    // BLOB
 	durableObject("Counter")                // DO_COUNTER
 }
Since:
1.0.0
